senses.gloss: m. (part. Hif. of עָלָה); מַעֲלֵה עָשָׁן Smoke-Raiser, name of a plant used as an ingredient of frankincense (Fumitory?).
units: Tosef. Yoma I, 8 (ref. to בענן, Lev. XVI, 2) מלמד שנותן בו מ׳ ע׳ this intimates that he must add maʿăle ʿashan. [Ib. II, 6; Y. ib. III, 41ᵃ היו בקיאין … במ׳ ע׳ understood how to make the smoke of the frankincense rise; Bab. ib. 38ᵃ להעלות ע׳.]
